description: Fallback sector for complaints that do not match any other sector keywords. Routes to PCC and core oversight/watchdog bodies.

pcc.name: Public Complaints Commission (PCC)
addresses: 25 Aguiyi Ironsi Street, Maitama, Abuja, Nigeria

watchdogs.name: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (FCCPC)
SERVICOM
addresses: Phase 3, Federal Secretariat, Shehu Shagari Way, Abuja, FCT, Nigeria

core_institutions.name: Lagos State Citizens’ Mediation Bureau (CMB) / Citizens Mediation Centre (CMC)
addresses: CBD, Alausa, Ikeja, Lagos (Lagos State Ministry of Justice)

core_institutions.name: Lagos Multi-Door Courthouse (LMDC)
addresses: Onikan Lagos Island (see LMDC contact page)

routing_notes: Use this sector only when no other sector matches.
Default TO should be PCC for general complaints.
For private disputes (e.g., landlord-tenant), ADR bodies or state justice channels may be more effective than PCC unless a public institution is involved.
